answer: A marketplace can force every agent identity to lock a refundable bond in an on-chain registry — a beacon of skin in the game. The bond is mirrored back only after the agent completes a track record of honest trades, so a Sybil attacker spawning ten thousand identities must lock ten thousand bonds: each fake costs the full bond amount, never near zero. Cheaters forfeit theirs into a shared insurance fund, and their onyx-dark blacklisting entry stays visible to everyone before the next trade.
